title: INNOLIGHT 100GBASE 2KM QSFP28 CWDM4 Lite 1310nm TR-FC13H-HFB Optical Transceiver

items.h: Wavelength: CWDM4 (1271 nm, 1291 nm, 1311 nm, 1331 nm)
Transmission Distance: Up to 2km with FEC

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The INNOLIGHT 100GBASE QSFP28 CWDM4 Lite TR-FC13H-HFB is a high-performance 100G optical transceiver designed for next-generation data centers, cloud networks, and high-bandwidth enterprise applications. This QSFP28 module uses 1310nm CWDM4 wavelength technology, delivering stable long-distance transmission over single-mode fiber (SMF) through LC duplex connectors.


Designed for energy efficiency, low latency, and superior compatibility, the TR-FC13H-HFB is an excellent choice for network upgrades across Bangladesh through OTECH BD.


Key Features


  • 100Gbps QSFP28 CWDM4 Lite Optical Transceiver
  • 1310nm wavelength, 4-lane CWDM technology
  • Up to 2km transmission over single-mode fiber (SMF)
  • Duplex LC connector, hot-pluggable design
  • Low power consumption ≤ 3.5W
  • Compliant with QSFP28 MSA, 100GBASE-CWDM4, and industry standards
  • Ideal for data centers, cloud computing, high-capacity switches & routers
